---
title: "Integrated Douyin and KuGou EDA"
author: "Music Platform Data Project"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5, dpi = 120)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(jsonlite)
library(plotly)

root <- normalizePath("..", mustWork = TRUE)
panel <- read_csv(file.path(root, "data/processed/platform_song_daily_panel.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(observation_date = as.Date(observation_date))
coding <- read_csv(file.path(root, "data/processed/platform_song_coding.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
combined <- read_csv(file.path(root, "data/audit/platform_combined_overlap_observations.csv"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(observation_date = as.Date(observation_date))

theme_platform <- theme_minimal(base_size = 10) + theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, colour = "#263B4D"),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 9, colour = "#374151"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "#4B5563"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E5E7EB", linewidth = .35),
  legend.position = "bottom"
)
platform_cols <- c(Douyin = "#D97968", KuGou = "#4F8197")

shared_panel <- panel |>
  group_by(cross_platform_song_id, observation_date) |>
  summarise(
    douyin_observed = as.integer(any(douyin_observed == 1)),
    kugou_observed = as.integer(any(kugou_observed == 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shared_stats <- shared_panel |>
  group_by(cross_platform_song_id) |>
  summarise(
    douyin_days = sum(douyin_observed),
    kugou_days = sum(kugou_observed),
    intersection_days = sum(douyin_observed == 1 & kugou_observed == 1),
    union_days = sum(douyin_observed == 1 | kugou_observed == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(temporal_jaccard = intersection_days / union_days)

parse_labels <- function(x) {
  purrr::map_chr(x, function(value) {
    if (is.na(value) || value == "") return(NA_character_)
    parsed <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(value), error = function(e) character())
    paste(as.character(parsed), collapse = "|")
  })
}

label_counts <- function(data, field, n = 10) {
  data |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[field]]), .data[[field]] != "") |>
    mutate(label = parse_labels(.data[[field]])) |>
    separate_rows(label, sep = "\\|") |>
    filter(!is.na(label), label != "") |>
    count(platform, label, sort = TRUE) |>
    group_by(platform) |>
    slice_head(n = n) |>
    ungroup()
}
```

# 1. Data Quality and Scope

Data quality is checked before any exploratory figure is produced. The integrated dataset covers 14 November 2024 to 13 November 2026. The daily panel contains `r nrow(panel)` song-date rows and `r nrow(coding)` title-coding rows. The observation layer contains `r nrow(combined)` platform records: `r sum(combined$platform == "douyin")` Douyin records and `r sum(combined$platform == "kugou")` KuGou records.

The integrated analysis keeps original platform records and uses title-based matching only as an exploratory cross-platform key. Missing native metrics mean that a song was not observed on that platform that day; they are not replaced with zero. Duplicate platform-date-track keys are checked before aggregation, and daily visibility is reduced to one song-date record using `any(observed == 1)`.

```{r quality}
quality <- combined |>
  group_by(platform) |>
  summarise(
    records = n(), dates = n_distinct(observation_date),
    tracks = n_distinct(platform_track_id),
    missing_title = sum(is.na(title) | title == ""),
    duplicate_track_date = n() - n_distinct(paste(observation_date, platform_track_id)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
quality
```

# 2. Platform Coverage and Song Overlap

The first comparison describes the available candidate sets. Shared songs are counted by `cross_platform_song_id`; they are not treated as confirmed identical recordings because the matching key is normalized title only.

```{r coverage}
coverage <- coding |>
  mutate(platform_group = case_when(
    both_platforms == 1 ~ "Shared title candidates",
    platforms == "douyin" ~ "Douyin only",
    platforms == "kugou" ~ "KuGou only",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) |>
  count(platform_group) |>
  mutate(platform_group = fct_reorder(platform_group, n))

ggplot(coverage, aes(platform_group, n, fill = platform_group)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = .7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n)), hjust = -.1, size = 3.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Douyin only" = "#D97968", "KuGou only" = "#4F8197", "Shared title candidates" = "#D6A85F")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .12))) +
  labs(title = "Platform Candidate Coverage", x = NULL, y = "Title candidates") +
  theme_platform
```

# 3. Observation Volume and Time Structure

This interactive figure supports hover, zoom and a range slider to inspect time coverage. It is not used to create a common popularity score.

```{r daily-interactive, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}
daily_counts <- combined |>
  count(platform, observation_date, name = "records") |>
  mutate(platform = recode(platform, douyin = "Douyin", kugou = "KuGou"))

p_daily <- ggplot(daily_counts, aes(observation_date, records, colour = platform,
                                   text = paste0(platform, "<br>Date: ", observation_date,
                                                 "<br>Records: ", records))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .45) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = platform_cols) +
  labs(title = "Daily Observation Volume", x = "Observation date", y = "Records") +
  theme_platform
ggplotly(p_daily, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(hovermode = "x unified", width = 1000, height = 450)
```

# 4. Shared Songs: Visibility and Temporal Overlap

For the 95 shared title candidates, each point represents one candidate. Repeated source rows do not receive extra weight.

```{r paired-days}
ggplot(shared_stats, aes(douyin_days, kugou_days)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "#9CA3AF") +
  geom_point(colour = "#4F8197", alpha = .7, size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Observed Days for Shared Title Candidates",
       x = "Douyin observed days", y = "KuGou observed days") +
  theme_platform
```

```{r temporal-overlap}
ggplot(shared_stats, aes(temporal_jaccard)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = .05, boundary = 0, fill = "#D97968", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(shared_stats$temporal_jaccard),
             colour = "#263B4D", linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "Temporal Overlap of Shared Title Candidates",
       x = "Temporal Jaccard index", y = "Candidates") +
  theme_platform
```

```{r monthly-patterns}
monthly <- shared_panel |>
  mutate(month = floor_date(observation_date, "month")) |>
  summarise(
    Douyin = sum(douyin_observed), KuGou = sum(kugou_observed),
    Both = sum(douyin_observed == 1 & kugou_observed == 1),
    .by = month
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-month, names_to = "platform", values_to = "observed_song_days")

ggplot(monthly, aes(month, observed_song_days, colour = platform)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) + geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Douyin = "#D97968", KuGou = "#4F8197", Both = "#D6A85F")) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Observation Pattern of Shared Candidates",
       x = "Month", y = "Observed candidate-days", colour = NULL) +
  theme_platform
```

# 5. Genre and Mood Composition

Genre and mood are analysed from the platform observation layer. Because fields can contain multiple labels, counts are label counts rather than mutually exclusive song counts. Platform labels remain separate and are not treated as one unified taxonomy.

```{r genre}
genre_counts <- label_counts(combined, "genre")
ggplot(genre_counts, aes(reorder(label, n), n, fill = platform)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = platform_cols) +
  labs(title = "Top Genre Labels by Platform", x = NULL,
       y = "Label occurrences", fill = NULL) +
  theme_platform
```

```{r mood}
mood_counts <- label_counts(combined, "mood")
ggplot(mood_counts, aes(reorder(label, n), n, fill = platform)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = platform_cols) +
  labs(title = "Top Mood Labels by Platform", x = NULL,
       y = "Label occurrences", fill = NULL) +
  theme_platform
```

# 6. Main Findings and Limits

- The available candidate sets are highly asymmetric: KuGou contributes many more title candidates, while only a smaller subset is shared by title matching.
- Shared title candidates are not necessarily the same recording; version, artist and recording identity are not fully validated.
- Shared candidates show different observed-day patterns across platforms, and temporal overlap is generally limited.
- Genre and mood comparisons are descriptive because labels may be multi-valued and platform taxonomies differ.
- Platform-native metrics remain separate. The EDA supports coverage, visibility, temporal overlap and composition analysis, but not a unified popularity score or causal conclusion.

The next step can use the shared candidate ID for exploratory interaction analysis with Douyin, while preserving `platform_record_id` and the original platform rows for version-level checks.
